history.dynasty: Vijayanagara (1413 inscription); Yadava-period copper plate (1222 AD); sculpture evidence 7th–8th century
history.period: Ancient — temple likely existed before the 7th century; current building renovated 1780, again 1877
history.summary: An ancient swayambhu Shiva temple, one of the few in Goa that stands on its original site, unaffected by Portuguese persecution because Antruz (Ponda Mahal) was outside Portuguese domain. A 1413 AD stone inscription (Shaka 1335, reign of Vijayanagara king Veer Pratap Devaraya, governor Nanjan Gosavi) records land grants by Mai Shenvi Wagle to the deities Shree Nagesh and Shree Mahalakshmi; a Savoi-Verem copper plate of 1222 AD names the deity 'Shree Nagnath' of Bandivade. Stone idols of Shiva-Parvati (7th c.) and Ganesha (8th c.) in the precinct support an antiquity before the 7th century. The sabhamandap has wood-carved galleries depicting Ramayana/Mahabharata and the Astadikpals; a five-storied deepstambha and an ancient tali (tank) famous for its reflection of the deity complete the complex. The temple has recently barred entry to foreigners over conduct/dress. CSV TOWN CORRECTED: the temple is at Nagueshi (Donshiwadi, Bandode village), about 4 km east of Ponda — not in Ponda town. Note: Ponda taluka is now in South Goa district.

name: Nagesh (Naguesh) Temple
town_description: Nagueshi is a small temple village in Bandode (Donshiwadi) near Farmagudi in Ponda taluka, set amid hills, betel-nut plantations and sweet-water springs. The village takes its name from the ancient Shree Nagesh temple at its heart, one of the Ponda region's oldest shrines. It lies about 800 m off the Farmagudi–Kavlem–Ponda road, roughly 4 km from Ponda town.

travel.railway: Madgaon railway station, about 20 km (verify); Ponda has no railway station
travel.road: 800 m off the Farmagudi–Kavlem–Ponda road, about 4 km east of the Ponda bus stand; agrashalas (pilgrim rest houses) are available near the temple

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Chaitra Purnima (Mahaparvani Mahotsav) is the main festival
